name: runs_write

ops.description: Operations, one flat object each, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

rootId.description: The root item the run belongs to. Item id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: open]

items.description: Member items, at most 500. Each is an item of the root that has a lifecycle and is in no other open run. [ops: open]

scopeId.description: An item the run is scoped to. Item id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: open]

label.description: A short label, at most 64 characters. [ops: open]

title.description: A title, at most 200 characters. [ops: open]

budget.description: Run budget: attemptsPerSeat, maxActiveSeats; absent means no cap. On open it may not exceed a configured ceiling; on update a field can only be lowered or newly set. [ops: open]

attemptsPerSeat.description: Most attempts one seat may take.

stallAfterSeconds.description: Seconds without a sign of life from the run's orchestrator before the run reads as stalled. Default from config. [ops: open]

hints.description: Short structured hints for the run's orchestrator, string to string. On update they replace the stored hints. [ops: open]

runId.description: Run id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: close, pause, resume]

reason.description: Why the run ends: completed, cancelled, failed or abandoned. completed is refused while a seat is active. [ops: close]

decisionId.description: Decision id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: ack, answer, withdraw]

option.description: Key of the chosen option. [ops: answer]

text.description: Free-form answer, at most 1000 characters; freeform classes only. [ops: answer]

rationale.description: Why this answer, at most 1000 characters. [ops: answer]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return each operation's parameters and errors; nothing runs.

description: Open, close, pause and resume runs; ack, answer and withdraw decisions. Each op needs the runs capability (ack, answer: decide) and a root in scope. close: run token, director or a human; pause and resume: director or human only. Result: the run (close adds snapshot) or the decision. Call with describe:true for parameters and errors.
